CustomField.description: Linked Lead record for website applicants. Used when Interview is created from a Job Submission that has a Lead (not Candidate). Enables interview tracking for website applicants.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Auto-populated by Flow 4 (Create Interview) from JS.Lead__c. Either Candidate or Lead must be filled. When Lead is later converted to Person Account, all linked Interviews migrate automatically.
CustomField.label: Lead
